---
title: "analyses - export"
output: html_document
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

With this syntax, the calculated results are saved in .xlsx files that can be exported from the CBS environment. 

# export
```{r export}
library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(mstate)
library(reshape2)

wb_export <- createWorkbook()
```  
```{r cohort counts}
#### cohort counts ####
addWorksheet(wb_export, "cohort_counts")
writeData(wb_export, "cohort_counts", readRDS("analyses_clean/data_2020_2021.rds") %>%
            count(sex_age) %>% 
            mutate(n = ifelse(n >= 10, n, NA)))
```
```{r ratetables}
### ratetable ####
addWorksheet(wb_export, "ratetable")
writeData(wb_export, "ratetable",
          melt(as.matrix(readRDS("nedpop2.rds")), 
               varnames = names(dimnames(readRDS("nedpop2.rds"))),
               value.name = "nedpop2") %>%
            full_join(melt(as.matrix(readRDS("nedpop_1519.rds")), 
                           varnames = names(dimnames(readRDS("nedpop_1519.rds"))),
                           value.name = "nedpop_1519")) %>%
            full_join(melt(as.matrix(readRDS("nedpop_year.rds")), 
                           varnames = names(dimnames(readRDS("nedpop_year.rds"))),
                           value.name = "nedpop_year")) %>%
            mutate(year = as.factor(year)) %>%
            full_join(melt(as.matrix(readRDS("nedpop_months.rds")), 
                           varnames = names(dimnames(readRDS("nedpop_months.rds"))),
                           value.name = "nedpop_months")))
```

```{r mstate counts}
#### mstate at risk numbers ####
addWorksheet(wb_export, "mstate_counts")
writeData(wb_export, "mstate_counts", readRDS("df_ms_counts.rds") %>% 
            mutate(n = ifelse(n >= 10, n, NA)))

addWorksheet(wb_export, "mstate_counts_l")
writeData(wb_export, "mstate_counts_l", 
          readRDS("ms3_s_June.rds") %>%
            group_by(RINPERSOON, Tstart, Tstop) %>%
            mutate(Tstop2 = ifelse(all(status == 0), Tstop, Tstop - 1)) %>%
            ungroup() %>%
            select(RINPERSOON, sex_age, from, Tstart, Tstop2) %>% 
            unique() %>%
            count(sex_age, from, Tstart, Tstop2) %>%
            rowwise() %>%
            do(data.frame(
              from = .$from, sex_age = .$sex_age, n = .$n,
              time = seq(.$Tstart, .$Tstop2, by = 1))) %>%
            group_by(from, sex_age, time) %>%
            summarise(n = sum(n)) %>%
            ungroup() %>%
            filter(n >= 10) %>%
            left_join(
              data.frame(
                from = 1:length(readRDS("analyses_clean/tmat3_s.rds")),
                state = factor(rownames(readRDS("analyses_clean/tmat3_s.rds")), 
                               levels = c(rownames(readRDS("analyses_clean/tmat3_s.rds"))))),
              by = "from") %>%
            pivot_wider(id_cols = c(state, time, total), names_from = sex_age, values_from = n))
```

```{r mstate nedpop2 Haz}
            ungroup() %>%
            filter(!is.na(Haz)) %>%
            pivot_wider(id_cols = c("time"),
```

```{r mstate_Haz_nedpop_1519}
            filter(Haz != 0 & !is.na(toname)) %>%
            arrange(trans, time) %>%
            group_by(trans, name, start, from) %>%
            mutate(Haz = ifelse(!is.na(lag(Haz)) & lag(Haz) == Haz, NA, Haz)) %>%
            ungroup() %>%
            filter(!is.na(Haz)) %>%
            pivot_wider(id_cols = c("time"), 
                        names_from = c("name", "start", "from", "trans"), names_sep = "_", 
                        values_from = "Haz", names_sort = T) %>%
            arrange(time))
```

```{r cuminc}
#### cumulative incidences of infection and vaccination ####
addWorksheet(wb_export, "cuminc")
writeData(wb_export, "cuminc", 
          rbind(readRDS("fit_inf_deathComp.rds") %>% select(-contains("Surv")) %>% 
                  pivot_longer(-time, names_to = c("measure","endpoint"),
                               values_to = "value", names_pattern = "(.*)\\.(.*)") %>%
                  mutate(group = "total", model = "InfdeathComp"),
                readRDS("fit_inf_deathComp_subsets.rds") %>% select(-contains("Surv")) %>%
                  pivot_longer(-c(time,group), names_to = c("measure","endpoint"),
                               values_to = "value", names_pattern = "(.*)\\.(.*)") %>%
                  mutate(model = "InfdeathComp"),
                
                readRDS("fit_vacc_deathComp.rds") %>% select(-contains("Surv")) %>% 
                  pivot_longer(-time, names_to = c("measure","endpoint"),
                               values_to = "value", names_pattern = "(.*)\\.(.*)") %>%
                  mutate(group = "total", model = "VaccdeathComp"),
                readRDS("fit_vacc_deathComp_subsets.rds") %>% select(-contains("Surv")) %>%
                  pivot_longer(-c(time,group), names_to = c("measure","endpoint"),
                               values_to = "value", names_pattern = "(.*)\\.(.*)") %>%
                  mutate(model = "VaccdeathComp")
                ) %>%
            filter(value != 0) %>%
            pivot_wider(id_cols = c(time, model),
                        names_from = c(group, endpoint, measure), names_sep = "_", 
                        values_from = value))
```

The .xlsx file may be too big to export in one piece -> split into multiple files for export and outside of the CBS environment, combine it to a single file again and process it with func_prob() from the .Rmd file "outside CBS - show results"
